description.la: Libellus spiritualis exercitii: de fervida exhortatione ad virtutes, de elevatione et directione mentis ad Deum, et de exercitiis cotidianis.
description.en-US: Twelve chapters on the daily spiritual exercise of the religious: fervour in the virtues, lifting and directing the mind to God, examination, prayer and the preparation for death. Latin only: Pohl's critical edition (Freiburg 1904), from a raw OCR of the printed volume; no public-domain English translation has been found.
description.pt-BR: Doze capítulos sobre o exercício espiritual cotidiano do religioso: fervor nas virtudes, elevação da mente a Deus, exame, oração e preparação para a morte.

sources.edition: Thomae Hemerken a Kempis Libellus spiritualis exercitii, ed. M. J. Pohl (Freiburg: Herder 1904), Opera omnia II; archive.org raw OCR.
sources.description: Pohl's text without his critical apparatus and introduction; line numbers, running heads and page breaks stripped by script, upper-case chapter titles recased (u/v normalised by script). Raw OCR: drop capitals at openings are often garbled and some slips remain after the scripted lexicon repair.
